design_statement: Output list hd has counts_2um: sparse genes x 2 um bins over the whole simulated area (tissue, lumens, glass).
code_behaviour: dgCMatrix G x (n_row*n_col) over every grid bin, tissue or not.

design_statement: counts_8um is the 4 x 4 sum of the 2 um bins, as Space Ranger.
code_behaviour: X8 <- sum_to_8um(X2, g): sparse aggregation matrix over blocks (i %/% 4, j %/% 4).

design_statement: bins: one row per bin with grid row and column, centre in um, tissue fraction, in_tissue (fraction >= 0.5).
code_behaviour: bins = hd_bin_table() + tissue_area_um2, tissue_frac, in_tissue = tissue_frac >= 0.5; capture adds column c.

design_statement: truth$overlap: per (bin, cell) fraction of bin area covered by the cell territory and by its nucleus.
code_behaviour: Rows with territory area > 0: area_territory_um2, area_nucleus_um2, frac_territory, frac_nucleus (area / bin_um^2).

design_statement: truth$origin: per (bin, cell) captured transcripts from that cell 'plus the background share' (cell also notes S2.4 moved background apart).
code_behaviour: origin holds captured cell transcripts only; background is in truth$background (bin_id, n).

design_statement: truth$cell_counts: genes x cells matrix of transcripts generated per cell, before displacement and technical capture.
code_behaviour: cell_counts = prof$counts, generated with depth_factor x M (overgenerated scale).

design_statement: truth$layers: active technical layers and values (row/column stripe factors, background, displacement parameters).
code_behaviour: layers = stripes, background, second_tail, overgeneration, diffusion, field, depth.

design_statement: metadata: pixel_size_um inherited from Step 1, seed, preset, version.
code_behaviour: metadata has pixel_size_um, seed, step1 preset, hand-written package_version string '(S2.5)'.

design_statement: simulate_visium_hd(cell_layer, seed, archetype, layers, frame_open, profiles, depth_factor, chunk_size, chunk_transcripts = 2e6, ...).
code_behaviour: Same leading signature; extra args component_seeds, hd, workers, verbose; chunk_transcripts default 2e6.

design_statement: Outputs also bins_8um and 8 um truth sums overlap_8um, origin_8um, background_8um.
code_behaviour: bins_8um from build_hd_grid; .s25_to_8um for overlap and origin; sum_to_8um for background.

design_statement: truth$arrived_2um: transcripts arrived per 2 um bin before capture.
code_behaviour: arr = rowsum of transcript triples by bin_id, before thinning.

design_statement: truth$cells (type, subtype, generated, captured, lost, expected) and a gene table.
code_behaviour: cells: cell_type, subtype, n_transcripts_generated, n_generated, n_lost, n_thinned, n_captured, n_expected_captured; genes from capture.

design_statement: metadata holds the seeds of the four random steps, layers, overgeneration factor M, chunks, per-step times.
code_behaviour: component_seeds, layers, overgeneration, chunk_size, chunk_transcripts, elapsed_s per step.

design_statement: The user's RNG state is left as it was (DEC-068).
code_behaviour: RNGkind and .Random.seed saved and restored on.exit; Box-Muller normal.kind internal state not restored.
evidence: 05b5:108-111; BL-238 'memoria interna di Box-Muller non si ripristina'

design_statement: Section 1 names simulate_visium_hd() as the only entry point of Step 2.
code_behaviour: A second exported engine exists (S2.7): pieces, 56 um RNG tiles, same output structure.

design_statement: Output structure as listed in section 1 (counts_2um, truth$overlap, ...).
code_behaviour: assemble = 'light' returns umi_2um, counts_8um, bins, bins_8um, reduced truth; not described in design.

design_statement: truth$layers carries the stripe layer with its overgeneration M (as in simulate_visium_hd).
code_behaviour: layers$stripes$M is the raw grid maximum, while overgeneration used is M* (metadata$overgeneration); bins$c truncated, bins$c_raw raw.

design_statement: metadata records the version for reproducibility.
code_behaviour: Hand-written version '(S2.7)'; resume fingerprint run.rds omits code version and profiles, so stale files can be reused.

design_statement: 2 um grid built from Step 1 scale metadata$pixel_size_um, with no default value.
code_behaviour: Error if pixel_size_um missing or invalid; value copied to metadata (coordinates already in um).

design_statement: Simulated area = bounding box of the cells plus a glass margin; no subsampling of cells.
code_behaviour: bbox of territories and regions + margin_um; all cells kept (n_cells = length of territories).

design_statement: Transcripts generated per cell, placed inside the cell, displaced, then counted in bins; a bin has no profile of its own.
code_behaviour: Chain profiles -> place_and_move_transcripts -> capture_and_bin; no per-bin profile anywhere.

design_statement: Transcripts per cell per type in all tissues; where profiles come from R6 nuclei, each subtype has its own distribution (DEC-046).
code_behaviour: totals_by default from profile meta: 'subtype' for A1, A2, A4, A5, A6; 'type' for A3 (atlas).

design_statement: Nucleus has transcript density r times the cytoplasm; r per tissue inverted in S2.0; heart value with reservation.
code_behaviour: pn = r A_n / (r A_n + A_c) chooses nucleus vs cytoplasm; r from table per archetype.

design_statement: All transcripts get narrow blur 0.7 um, except those born near tissue or lumen edge (weight exp(-d/D)) with wide sigma_e; exponential tail for all.
code_behaviour: tail if u1 < w; else wide if u2 < exp(-d/D) with d at birth point; Gaussian per axis.

design_statement: Heart uses the median displacement values of the other sections (DEC-037).
code_behaviour: A6 sigma_e 4.859, D 15.49, w 0.0980, ell 32.96 = medians of A1, A2, A4, A5 values.

design_statement: Stripes of the 2 um grid are a switchable technical layer: odd/even parity plus a random factor per row and column.
code_behaviour: Parity per odd row/column times exp(alpha_i + beta_j); layer off via layers$stripes = FALSE or stripes = NULL.

design_statement: Multiplicative gamma field (mean 1, variance per tissue) on in presets, switchable; correlated field calibrated in S2.3.
code_behaviour: Gamma-copula field on 0.5 um subgrid, default field = TRUE; layers$field in orchestrators.

design_statement: No separate dropout process; per-cell profiles have subtypes or programmes.
code_behaviour: No dropout step; subtype drawn from type shares; programmes not implemented.

design_statement: Depth factor per tissue reproduces true 2 um tissue UMI; tuned in S2.2 and verified in S2.5.
code_behaviour: Preset default is the S2.5 full-chain retuned factor (rule R-2), not the S2.2 factor.

design_statement: Glass background: constant transcripts per bin with mean composition of generated transcripts, Poisson(b c_b); b = 0 in intestine, lymph node, heart.
code_behaviour: K ~ Poisson(b c) on every bin (tissue included); genes by generated composition; b 0 for A1, A4, A6.

design_statement: Acellular space inside tissue absent by construction; lumens and glass receive only displaced transcripts and background.
code_behaviour: Births only in territories; in-tissue bins without any territory are kept as tissue (DEC-066).

design_statement: All bin-polygon geometric overlaps use overlay_prec (1e-6 um rounding), never sf::st_intersection on territories.
code_behaviour: overlay_prec('intersection', ...) with local tile origin; grep finds no st_intersection in R/05b*.R.

design_statement: Grid of 2 um squares with no gaps; i = row (y axis), j = column (x axis), numbered from 0 at origin (x0, y0).
code_behaviour: i, j from 0; bin_id = i * n_col + j + 1.

design_statement: Bin (i, j) centre is (x0 + (j + 0.5) 2, y0 + (i + 0.5) 2) um.
code_behaviour: x = x0 + (j + 0.5) bin_um, y = y0 + (i + 0.5) bin_um.

design_statement: Simulated area = box of territories and regions plus 280 um glass margin, a multiple of 8 um.
code_behaviour: Default margin_um = 280; error unless margin is a multiple of bin_um * block; origin = box min - margin.

design_statement: Grid dimensions make the 8 um sum complete.
code_behaviour: n_row and n_col rounded up to a multiple of block = 4.

design_statement: Tail mass beyond r is (1+r/l)exp(-r/l); with l = 41.5 um: 31 % beyond 100 um, 4.7 % beyond 200, 0.9 % beyond 280.
Transcripts leaving the simulated area are counted as lost.
code_behaviour: Arrival outside the grid -> NA bin, counted in lost per cell and per gene.

design_statement: A full capture area has 3 350 x 3 350 = 11.2 million bins.
The simulator works in tiles (section 12).
code_behaviour: Pieces of 504 um (default), multiple of 56 um RNG tiles; no border, transcripts passed to arrival piece.

design_statement: Row and column parity and stripe factors are tied to the bin index in the simulated grid.
code_behaviour: odd_r / odd_c from grid row/column index; alpha per row, beta per column; c in bin_id order.

design_statement: Old create_sampling_grid() (R/05_grid_sampling.R) is not used.
code_behaviour: grep finds no call to create_sampling_grid or any R/06* function in R/05b*.R.

design_statement: Number of cells is what Step 1 placed; a single scale.
code_behaviour: All territories used; n_cells = length(territories); every cell has bins.

design_statement: Geometric truth: per bin, area fraction covered by each territory and nucleus on the 2 um grid with the Step 1 overlay helper.
code_behaviour: Candidate pairs from territory boxes, per 500 um tile, overlay_prec areas; nucleus computed only where territory > 0.

design_statement: Sum of fractions of a bin <= 1; the remainder is glass, lumen or excluded region.
code_behaviour: Not checked at runtime; follows from non-overlapping territories.

design_statement: Each cell gets total N_c from its subtype distribution (R6 tissues) or type distribution (stroma, atlas).
code_behaviour: Random quantile of type or subtype totals (linear interpolation), times depth_factor, rounded, at least 1.

design_statement: N_c is on the captured-transcript scale (R4), so no second mean capture efficiency is needed.
code_behaviour: Only depth_factor (times M for thinning); stripes normalised to mean 1 on tissue, so expected capture = N_c.

design_statement: Expression profile p_c from the cell type, with a subtype or a programme (BL-194).
code_behaviour: Subtype drawn by share within type; profile row of subtype; programmes not implemented.

design_statement: Gene counts x_c ~ Multinomial(N_c, p_c) or negative binomial with per-gene dispersion; old R/06d_dispersion_params.R reusable.
code_behaviour: noise 'M' multinomial; 'G' gamma factor per gene (variance phi) then renormalised, fixed total; phi read from profile files.
evidence: 05b2:155-165; profiles meta noise G for A1, A2, A4, A5

design_statement: Profile source decided by data in S2.2 (R6 full footprint, nucleus-only, single-cell atlas).
code_behaviour: Reads winner files: exp_G (A1, A2, A4, A5), atlas_M (A3), exp_M (A6); result not written in design.

design_statement: Noise-model comparison (negative binomial vs scDesign3) is deferred to BL-203.
code_behaviour: No scDesign3 path in code.

design_statement: Zeros at 2 and 8 um are a consequence, not a parameter; step 6 checks them against R4.
code_behaviour: No dropout or zero-inflation parameter exists.

design_statement: Within-cell bin variability comes from displacement (step 4) plus the step-3 field.
code_behaviour: Field acceptance at birth, then displacement; no other per-bin noise.

design_statement: Transcripts placed uniformly in the cytoplasm and r times denser in the nucleus; r < 1 in A1-A4, r > 1 in A5, A6.
code_behaviour: Exact sampling by constrained triangles; r 0.746, 0.755, 0.821, 0.546, 1.483, 2.605.

design_statement: Position does not depend on the gene; per-gene nuclear enrichment not in the first version.
code_behaviour: Genes assigned in gene order to i.i.d. positions of the cell.

design_statement: Multiplicative gamma field of mean 1 on the fine transcript grid, short Gaussian correlation, applied before displacement.
code_behaviour: Gaussian Z (kernel SD L, 4 SD truncation), gamma quantile of Phi(Z); acceptance F/Fmax at birth.

design_statement: v is excess variance per 2 um bin, not pointwise field variance; field variance and L calibrated in S2.3 with stripes on.
code_behaviour: Code uses pointwise field_s2 and field_L from S2.3 rule R-1, not v.

design_statement: The field applies to all transcript sources, i.e. the whole tissue, not only the nucleus.
code_behaviour: Field realised over the box of regions and territories; acceptance applies to nucleus and cytoplasm births.

design_statement: Switchable layer: field = FALSE in place_and_move_transcripts() (earlier called intracell_noise).
code_behaviour: field = TRUE default; FALSE gives Fm = NULL (no acceptance step).

design_statement: Field calibrated on deep true-nucleus bins only (C-1, DEC-049); s2 and L in section 9.
code_behaviour: fld table per archetype, roxygen cites S2.3 rule R-1.

design_statement: Optional radial nucleus-to-periphery gradient (BL-087), off by default; S2.3 did not write it.
code_behaviour: No radial-gradient argument in place_and_move_transcripts().

design_statement: Exit rule chosen by S2.0 data: edge zone (C-2), over two populations and glass transport.
code_behaviour: Wide blur with probability exp(-d/D), d = distance of birth point from tissue edge.

design_statement: The exponential tail applies to all transcripts.
code_behaviour: tail <- u1 < w for every transcript, regardless of d.

design_statement: Per transcript: with prob. w tail E(l); else G(sigma_e) with prob. pi(d) = exp(-d/D), G(sigma_in) with 1 - pi(d).
code_behaviour: Exactly this mixture; mode 2 tail, 1 wide, 0 narrow.

design_statement: E(l) is exp(-r/l) normalised in the plane (K2 of R5).
code_behaviour: Radius Gamma(shape 2, scale ell), uniform angle (planar density proportional to exp(-r/ell)).

design_statement: G(sigma) is the isotropic 2D Gaussian with SD sigma per axis.
code_behaviour: dx, dy = rnorm * sigma independently.

design_statement: d is the distance of the source (birth point) from the tissue edge.
code_behaviour: Exact EDT of region mask on 0.5 um subgrid, read at birth subpixel.

design_statement: In lumens the rule uses the distance from the lumen edge.
code_behaviour: Mask from region polygons with holes; lumen edges are mask edges.

design_statement: Second tail (mode 3): prob. w2, radius Gamma(2, l2), uniform angle, drawn after S2.3 draws; w2 = 0 identical to S2.3.
code_behaviour: Extra runif only if w2 > 0; replaces arrival from birth point.

design_statement: b, w2 and l2 fitted jointly on glass at every distance (DEC-053).
code_behaviour: b, w2, ell2 in .s24_tab per section, roxygen cites S2.4 rule R-3.

design_statement: Margin stays 280 um; transcripts leaving the grid are lost.
code_behaviour: Default 280 in build_hd_grid; hard-coded 280 in pieces engine.

design_statement: With frame_open the second tail is folded into the frame by reflection (DEC-054).
code_behaviour: Repeated reflection on frame sides for mode 3 only.

design_statement: frame_open refers to cut areas; the frame is the cut window.
code_behaviour: Frame = box of regions and territories, not the window of the area (BL-237); pieces accept 'frame'.

design_statement: Design describes frame_open only for second-tail folding.
code_behaviour: frame_open also removes the frame as edge for d (mask padded); in pieces 'frame' sets both (BL-248).

design_statement: c_ij = p(parity i, parity j) exp(alpha_i + beta_j), normalised to mean 1 over tissue bins of the simulated area.
code_behaviour: craw = exp(log parity + alpha + beta); c = craw / mean(craw[in_tissue]).

design_statement: Periodic part separable p_r(i mod 2) p_c(j mod 2); if not separable, use the four measured classes.
code_behaviour: Separable form only, p(even) = 1; no four-class path.
evidence: 05b4:113; no separability check found in S2.0.md, S2.4.md, DEC-039 (grep 'separab')

design_statement: Mean of exp(alpha + beta) before normalisation is exp((s_a^2 + s_b^2)/2), 1.04-1.06 with section 9 values.
code_behaviour: From code values: A1 1.036, A2/A3 1.044, A4 1.055, A5 1.047, A6 1.035; normalisation applied anyway.

design_statement: Parity constant over a section except lymph node; values in section 9.
code_behaviour: parity_field only for A4; one parity_row/parity_col per section.

design_statement: Only the fine part of row/column factors (residual from 21-row moving average); slow trends not reproduced.
code_behaviour: Slow part table .s24_slow is empty, so slow = NULL and no slow term is added.

design_statement: Rows and columns with tissue but zero UMI removed before estimation (values PH-5).
code_location: none (estimation in tools/; values in capture_params)
code_behaviour: Values carry PH-5 numbers, e.g. A4 parity_row 0.996.

design_statement: alpha_i, beta_j Gaussian, centred, SD of fine part, MA(1) x_i = (e_i + theta e_{i-1}) / sqrt(1 + theta^2), theta from rho.
code_behaviour: Same formula times sd; theta = 0 when rho = 0; error if |rho| > 0.5.

design_statement: Lymph node parity varies via smooth Gaussian field of log ratio, correlation length 300 um, SD 0.09 rows, 0.05 columns.
code_behaviour: Kernel SD 300/sqrt(2) um (correlation exp(-r^2/(2*300^2))); added on odd rows/columns only.

design_statement: Layer switched off with an argument stripes = FALSE.
code_behaviour: Switch is layers = list(stripes = FALSE) in orchestrators, stripes = NULL in capture_and_bin.

design_statement: Background K_b ~ Poisson(b c_b), genes with composition of generated transcripts; returned in truth$background, not in origin.
code_behaviour: rpois(nb, b * c); composition = arrived + lost per gene; bgdf(bin_id, n).

design_statement: Background uses the stripe factor c (no ceiling mentioned).
code_behaviour: Pieces: Poisson(b * c_t) with c_t = min(c_raw, M*), the truncated factor.

design_statement: Displaced transcripts and background counted in the bin where they fall.
code_behaviour: floor of arrival coordinates gives bin; background rows added to the same sparse matrix.

design_statement: Thinning: generate N_c max(c)/mean(c), keep each with prob. c_bin/max(c); integer counts, exact origin truth.
code_behaviour: rbinom(n, c_b / C) per triple; profiles with depth x M; nucleus-born hypergeometric.

design_statement: Overgeneration factor max(c)/mean(c) is computed per tile (not on the whole area).
code_behaviour: C = max(c) over the whole grid; the next sentence of the design (S2.4) already says so.

design_statement: C = max of c over the whole area grid (S2.4).
code_behaviour: Pieces: fixed ceiling M* = 1 - 1e-5 quantile of c law; c above M* truncated.

design_statement: M per area 2.9-5.8 (S2.4 measurement).
code_behaviour: No code counterpart.

design_statement: Profiles generated with depth factor x M; argument overgeneration controlled.
code_behaviour: Error unless overgeneration equals stripes$M within 1e-12; orchestrator passes M.

design_statement: Seeds reshuffled with Mersenne-Twister before L'Ecuyer-CMRG (DEC-057).
code_behaviour: Done in stripes and capture; profiles and placement still call set.seed(seed) directly (BL-224).

design_statement: counts_8um sums the 16 bins of each 8 um block (blocks of 4 rows and columns, as Space Ranger).
code_behaviour: Sparse 0/1 aggregation, bin8 = (i %/% 4) * nc8 + j %/% 4 + 1.

design_statement: Origin and geometric truth are summed to 8 um the same way.
code_behaviour: rowsum by (bin8, cell) for overlap and origin; fractions over 64 um^2.

design_statement: Check: each 8 um bin equals the exact integer sum of its 16 bins.
code_behaviour: Pieces engine checks nnzero(X8s - X8) == 0.

design_statement: capture_and_bin() returns counts_2um and counts_8um; 8 um truth computed by the orchestrator.
code_behaviour: As stated; orchestrator uses .s25_to_8um (equal to sum_to_8um by cell).

design_statement: Per (block, cell) 8 um truth exact in 150 of 150 S2.5 runs.
code_behaviour: No package code; check outside R/.

design_statement: Transcripts per cell: per type, median and dispersion of R4 (all six tissues).
code_behaviour: Quantiles per subtype from R6 nuclei (totals_by 'subtype') in A1, A2, A4, A5, A6; per type in A3.

design_statement: Nucleus/cytoplasm ratio r: 0.75, 0.75, 0.82, 0.55, 1.48, 2.61.
Narrow blur sigma_in = 0.7 um in all tissues (DEC-038).
code_behaviour: p$sigma_in <- 0.7 for every archetype.

design_statement: Glass background b: 0, 0.174, 0.174, 0, 0.147, 0 UMI per bin (DEC-053, replaces R5 far-glass).
code_behaviour: b = 0, 0.1736, 0.1736, 0, 0.1474, 0; used by both orchestrators.

design_statement: b from DEC-053 replaces the R5 far-glass background for the simulator.
code_behaviour: Still returns b = 0.161, 0.197, 0.197, 0.042, 0.309, 0.117 (R5), roxygen says used by capture; orchestrators ignore it.

design_statement: SD of fine row factors alpha (log): 0.193, 0.221, 0.221, 0.211, 0.242, 0.183.
SD of fine column factors beta (log): 0.185, 0.191, 0.191, 0.251, 0.180, 0.188.

code_behaviour: rho_alpha, rho_beta match to 3 decimals for all sections.

design_statement: Within-nucleus v as written by R-C, and v net of stripes (PH-2), are starting points, not simulator parameters.
code_behaviour: Code has no v parameter; uses field_s2 and field_L instead.

design_statement: Second tail length l2: 1 826, 429, 429, 1 575, 305, 113 um.
Fine field Gaussian kernel length L: 0.6375, 0.5, 0.85, 1.275, 1.275, 0.885 um.
code_behaviour: Same values.

design_statement: Scale of within-nucleus variability 1-2 um.
code_behaviour: No separate parameter.

design_statement: Preset depth factor before overgeneration: 1.0127, 0.9540, 1.5615, 0.8191, 1.4278, 2.9387 (DEC-067).
code_behaviour: Same values to 4 decimals; default when preset profiles used, in both engines.

design_statement: Reference rows (reg UMI, R4 UMI at 2 and 8 um, sparsity) are controls, not parameters.
code_behaviour: No code counterpart; used by S2.5 panel tools.

design_statement: Tumour (A2) and stroma (A3) share displacement, background and stripes of their section; r and v per tissue.
code_behaviour: A3 shares A2 sigma_e, D, w, ell; capture maps A2, A3 to 'A23'; r and field differ.

design_statement: In Step 1 every tissue point belongs to a cell territory; Step 2 adds no cell-free matrix.
code_behaviour: No source outside territories; Step 1 regions without cells kept as tissue bins with no territory.

design_statement: Within 8 um of lumen edges the model reproduces true lumens within a quarter; beyond 8 um it does not (BL-201).
code_behaviour: No lumen source in code.

design_statement: Option 'material in lumens' (weak uniform source) deferred until annotated lumens exist.
code_behaviour: Not implemented.

design_statement: Methods searching acellular space should be tested with large voids (BL-086).
code_behaviour: Guidance only.

design_statement: Bin-to-cell assignment truth: truth$origin (share of each cell per bin) and truth$overlap.
code_behaviour: Both returned.

design_statement: Deconvolution at 8 um: truth$origin summed to 8 um and aggregated by type.
code_behaviour: origin_8um per (block, cell); type aggregation left to user via truth$cells.

design_statement: Stripe correction truth: truth$layers$stripes (parity, row and column factors).
code_behaviour: alpha, beta, z_row, z_col, norm, C, M, seed, params (parity) copied into layers$stripes.

design_statement: Background truth: truth$layers$background and background share in truth$origin.
code_behaviour: layers$background (on, b); background counts in truth$background, not in origin.

design_statement: Displacement truth: parameters in truth$layers$diffusion; difference between overlap and origin.
code_behaviour: lay$diffusion = r, sigma_in, sigma_e, D, w, ell, w2, ell2.

design_statement: Expression truth: truth$cell_counts plus type and subtype per cell.
code_behaviour: cell_counts and cells (cell_type, subtype).

design_statement: 1 mm2 has 250 000 bins of 2 um.
Captured transcripts per mm2: 0.86 M heart, 11.4 M tumour, 10.4 M brain, 6.8 M intestine, 2.85 M lymph node.
code_location: none (arithmetic on B-327, B-280, B-315, B-270, B-302)

design_statement: A full capture area (11.2 M bins) is 45 times 1 mm2.
Budget: 1 mm2 in under 5 minutes and 8 GB.
code_behaviour: S2.7 pieces exceed 300 s per mm2 of tissue in tumour and intestine; declared limit (DEC-077) absent from design.
evidence: DEC-077; BL-246 (388 and 330 s per mm2)

design_statement: Full area in tiles of 500 um with a 280 um border, one process per tile.
code_behaviour: Pieces 504 um default (multiple of 56), no border: transcripts handed to arrival piece; one child per piece and stage.

design_statement: Step 1 lymph node 4 000 x 4 000 px exceeds budget (BL-144); BL-072, BL-045 to optimise first.
code_behaviour: Not Step 2 code; S2.6 measured superlinear Step 1 (BL-243, S1.7 queued).

design_statement: S2.5 measured 19-237 s per 1 mm2 area, peak 2.8-8.3 GB with 4e6 per block (above 8 GB only A2_r4).
code_behaviour: Default chunk_transcripts 2e6 after PH-1 (DEC-068).

design_statement: With 70.6 M generated transcripts the peak stays near 7 GB; a full capture area must be tiled (BL-214).
code_behaviour: Tiled engine exists; S2.7 per-piece peak under 4 GB with 504 um.

design_statement: After S2.5: the 280 um tile border predates the second tail; tiles and border to be re-measured (S2.6, BL-240).
code_behaviour: No border; second tail on the whole area; pieces bit-identical to one piece (S2.7 G-2).

design_statement: (not in design) Edge distance computed on piece windows with halo H = 25 D.
code_behaviour: Window enlarged by ceiling(25 D / step) subpixels.

design_statement: (not in design) At equal seed the two engines give different realisations of the same law, except the ceiling.
code_behaviour: RNG on 56 um tiles, six seed families; roxygen declares differences.

design_statement: Counts are exact integer identities: generated = captured + thinned + lost out of the simulated area.
code_behaviour: cells table n_generated, n_captured, n_thinned, n_lost; pieces check conservation_cell and conservation_total.

design_statement: Transcripts leaving a tile are counted in the neighbouring tile.
code_behaviour: Written per arrival piece, captured there; check sent_received.

design_statement: truth$cell_counts holds generated transcripts; expected captured N_c, generated N_c max(c)/mean(c).
code_behaviour: n_expected_captured = n_transcripts_generated / M; pieces divide by M* (DEC-075).

design_statement: Geometric tolerance: covered area vs expected within g sum(P) + n g^2, g = 1e-6 um; fractions divided by 4 um2.
code_behaviour: Protrusion warning uses grid_um (8 nk + 2 P) + (nk + 1) g^2; tests use tau of the pieces.

design_statement: Sum per region is tied to the grid, not to the region area (BL-146).
code_behaviour: Tissue area per bin summed over regions.

design_statement: Overlaps computed in local tile coordinates (BL-104), since absolute coordinates reach 1e4 um.
code_behaviour: origin = tile corner passed to overlay_prec.

design_statement: Simulated vs reference distributions: Monte Carlo error across seeds and pre-registered relevance intervals.
code_behaviour: No package code.
